newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares end flat, Air NZ sold after Qantas exit.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares end flat, Air NZ sold after Qantas exit.

text.p: * NZ market near technical support levels
* Both Air NZ stocks sold after Qantas sells stake
Richard Burton at Cavill White said some locals were selling "A" shares (which can only be held by New Zealanders) because they expected more activity in the "B"s.
But brokers said it was hard to justify the extent of the premium for the "B"s. "Either the 'B' shares are overpriced or the 'A' shares are underpriced," Burton said.

Telecom firmed as its buyback programme continued, but Carter Holt Harvey shed five cents to $2.98, its lowest since January last year, under the continued impact of increased competition in the domestic packaging and packaging materials market.
Burton said the top-40 index was now close to a five-year support level and he did not see it falling much further.
"The market's had an 11 percent correction from the top in January, so maybe that's enough for the short term. I think we might see the market stabilise here and then move ahead," he said.
